remarks: Welcome to this charming 3-bedroom bungalow situated on a massive lot in a quiet, neat, and peaceful Edmonton neighbourhood. The main floor features three comfortable bedrooms, a full bathroom, and an upgraded kitchen offering a refreshed and functional space for everyday living.  The property also offers a separate entrance to the unfinished basement, providing excellent potential for future redevelopment and additional living space, subject to the necessary permits and approvals.  The large lot with back-alley access creates exciting future possibilities, including the potential to develop a garage suite, subject to City of Edmonton zoning and development requirements.  Located in a convenient area in the heart of Edmonton, this property offers a great combination of comfortable living, a generous lot, and future development potential. An excellent opportunity for homeowners, investors, or buyers looking to add value over time. (id:67522)
